findings.highlight: from the moment we made our pact
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女と契約する前から
findings.governingReading: 契約する前から思い知らされていた places recognition before he takes her hand.
findings.explanation: Knowing the war presupposed death before the contract becomes knowing from the contract onward.

findings.highlight: But I still have something to do.
findings.evidenceJa: やるべき事を、やり通さなければ
findings.governingReading: やるべき事を、やり通さなければ insists on finishing what he must do despite loss of his means.
findings.explanation: The necessity to carry duty through becomes merely still having something to do.

findings.highlight: I touch the blood stain one last time.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後に長く、血の跡に指を這わせた
findings.governingReading: 最後に長く modifies the final movement of his finger over the blood before its release without bow or thanks.
findings.explanation: The last long touch loses its sustained duration.

findings.highlight: The pain in my left hand is gone.
findings.evidenceJa: 一際強く左手が痛み、消えた
findings.governingReading: Shirou's left hand hurts especially strongly before the disappearance. The following sentences explicitly identify the Command Spells as disappearing; the immediate subject of 消えた need not be forced.
findings.explanation: The English omits the final surge of pain before the marks disappear. It preserves their disappearance and the following explanation that Shirou has lost his qualification as a Master.

findings.highlight: I still haven't said anything about fighting or forfeiting the war.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ戦うつもりも何も、降りるなんて言った覚えはないからだ
findings.governingReading: まだ戦うつもりも何も dismisses the question of still fighting because he never said he was quitting.
findings.explanation: Having never said he would withdraw becomes having said nothing about fighting or forfeiting.

findings.highlight: Because she'll hear me, after all.
findings.evidenceJa: まじめに聞いてくるし
findings.governingReading: Shirou remarks that Rider is earnestly asking what he just said, adding to his embarrassment about thanking her.
findings.explanation: Rider's earnest request to repeat the thanks becomes Shirou's thought that she will hear him. The change removes his observation of how seriously she receives the unexpected gratitude.
